Watch Sarfarosh (1999), one of Bollywood's most celebrated action thrillers, starring Aamir Khan, Sonali Bendre, and Naseeruddin Shah in unforgettable performances. Directed by John Matthew Matthan, this critically acclaimed film combines patriotism, suspense, intense action, and emotional storytelling into a gripping cinematic experience.

The story follows Ajay Singh Rathod, a brilliant young medical student whose life changes forever after a devastating terrorist attack leaves his family shattered. Determined to fight crime and protect his nation, he joins the Indian Police Service (IPS) and embarks on a dangerous mission to dismantle terrorist networks operating across the country. As he gets closer to the truth, Ajay faces powerful enemies, hidden conspiracies, and difficult personal sacrifices in his relentless pursuit of justice.

Featuring a powerful screenplay, memorable performances, and a soulful soundtrack by Jatin–Lalit, Sarfarosh remains one of the finest patriotic action thrillers in Hindi cinema.
